### UTC Date & Time

Sep 21, 2026, 14:00 UTC

### Agenda

### UTC Date & Time

[September 14, 2026, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/sep-14-2026/2pm)

### Agenda

#### Discussions

##### Glamsterdam

* Devnet updates.
  * glamsterdam-devnet-8 / Plataberget.
  * glamsterdam-devnet-11: 
* Can we reduce `compute_min_epochs_for_block_requests()` post-[EIP-8061](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8061)? Whether we would reduce it and when. For more context, see [this thread](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1549841282652971111).
  - By @jihoonsong. 
* EIP-7928: align BAL retention with the history expiry window (3533 -> 33024 epochs).
  - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12347
  - Lighthouse (https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/10015), Teku, Prysm and Lodestar blind BALs or plan to and rebuild payloads from the EL.
  - By @nflaig.
* Glamsterdam Testnet quick check / heads up, (as discussed on #2222).
  * Sepolia is confirmed for October 6, epoch 353024, 13:53:36 UTC.
    * If you haven't, please review [ethclients/sepolia#126 - Schedule Sepolia Glamsterdam activation](https://github.com/eth-clients/sepolia/pull/126).
  * Client releases due September 29. Hoodi tentatively October 27, go/no-go on October 8.
    * https://github.com/ethereum/pm/pull/2205
    * https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12355
  * Sepolia shadowfork? 
  * execution-specs aim to include Amsterdam tests in a stable `v21.0.0` test release in the coming days:
    * https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/3217   
  * By @danceratopz and pandas/...

##### Hegota

* Preliminary Hegota devnet schedule ideas (with the goal of avoiding surprises later in the fork dev cycle).
  - By @spencer-tb.

#### EL Breakout

* Adding BPO test schedules to Amsterdam: 
  - Keep BPO3 and BPO4 schedules (based on Osaka) as-is until Glamsterdam fork.
  - Add new test schedules based on Amsterdam.
  - Name new test schedules `BPOIncrease` and `BPODecrease` (decouple from future BPO fork names).
  - By @danceratopz 
* Benchmarking?


#### CL Breakout

* Reference test updates: proposer preferences and BLS-to-execution-change gossip tests, https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5646 and https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5647.
  - By @mehdi-aouadi.
* Merging [Only return viable payload-status variants from get_head - #5509](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5509)? Here is a [related issue](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/5496).
  - By @jihoonsong.
 
#### Last ACDT 

- Call # 96  Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2217
- [ACDT # 96 on forkcast](https://forkcast.org/calls/acdt/096/) (with summary).

comments.body: Should we quickly discuss an _**initial**_ devnet plan for Hegota, i.e when are we launching frames/focil devnets? Should we interop EL/CL earlier in the process this time?

Can we discuss reducing `compute_min_epochs_for_block_requests()` post-EIP-8061? Whether we would reduce it and when. For more context, see [this thread](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1549841282652971111).

I would like to quickly mention https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5646 and https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5647 to update 2 reference tests (proposer preferences and bls to execution change gossip tests)

In the CL breakout, I'd like to ask whether we want to merge [#5509](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5509). Here is a [related issue](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/5496).

hegota psa: EIP-8142 (BiB) is being withdrawn/DFI by its champion, @kamilsa: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12072#issuecomment-5757125260. 8411 (fast execution broadcast) replaces it and requires CL team ratings ahead of next ACDC.
